cells.gaps: No source found says a body is designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI; the AI Commissioner would exist only under the AI Bill, which the Senate ICT Committee recommended not proceeding with in October 2026.
cells.note: The data protection act 2019 is reported to regulate automated decision-making, a rule in force that meets question 2, though the strategy says Kenya has no specific AI law. The AI Commissioner exists only in a bill the Senate committee advised against, so no authority is designated.
